title: Jalon Daniels continues to prove he belongs on the Buccaneers roster

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jalon Daniels continues to prove he belongs on the Buccaneers roster
sources.description: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers improved to 2-0 in the preseason Saturday night with a 16-15 comeback win over the Kansas City Chiefs, and rookie quarterback Jalon Daniels once again made his case for a roster spot. After Tampa Bay was held scoreless in the first half, Daniels helped provide the spark. The undrafted rookie out […]
